ALYGN

Hi Build at The House Fund,

Alygn is an independent AI governance institution focused on making accountability, oversight, and coordination workable for advanced AI systems operating at global scale.

As AI systems outgrow individual actors, governance can't be retrofitted. We exist to support coordination across developers, operators, and public institutions—without centralizing control or asserting authority.

Given The House Fund's focus on student founders and the next generation of AI leaders, you understand that governance frameworks must be built into AI education from the ground up.

We understand The House Fund faces challenges such as:

  • Student founder AI governance education
  • University AI safety culture
  • Next-gen AI leadership ethics

We're interested in exploring how governance infrastructure can support your organization's work.

Learn more about Alygn

P.S.: Your work with student founders aligns with our belief that the next generation of AI leaders must understand governance as core infrastructure.
